name: Amanatides–Woo Voxel Traversal
aliases: Amanatides and Woo Voxel Traversal Algorithm
Amanatides and Woo's Fast Voxel Traversal
A Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm for Ray Tracing
definition: A traversal algorithm for a uniform spatial grid that enumerates the grid cells intersected by a ray in front-to-back order by jumping exactly from one grid boundary to the next, avoiding the pitfalls of naïve ray marching (missing thin cells, redundant work, arbitrary step sizes).
summary: The Amanatides–Woo algorithm efficiently enumerates uniform grid cells intersected by a ray in front-to-back order by jumping between boundaries, avoiding the pitfalls of naive ray marching.
